# Stratton Defense Law Firm
> Debt settlement fraud litigation. Free case reviews for TSR, FDCPA, and UDAAP violations.

## About

Stratton Defense Law Firm represents consumers harmed by predatory debt settlement programs that violate federal law, including the FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule (TSR), the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), and UDAAP provisions enforced by the CFPB. We are a litigating law firm — not a debt relief company. We pursue legal action to recover fees paid to programs that violated the law.

**Jurisdiction:** California (and federal claims on behalf of US consumers)  
**Practice areas:** Consumer protection law · Debt settlement fraud · FDCPA defense · TSR violation recovery · Federal clawback litigation

## Public Pages

- [Home](https://strattondefense.com/) — Overview of firm services, evaluation form, and common violation patterns
- [Violations Checklist](https://strattondefense.com/violations-checklist) — TSR, FDCPA, and UDAAP violation reference guide; signals that a program may have crossed legal lines
- [Refund Expectations](https://strattondefense.com/refund-expectations) — How fee recovery claims are evaluated; illustrative case breakdown
- [Bankruptcy Myths](https://strattondefense.com/bankruptcy-myths) — Corrects common debt settlement industry misinformation about bankruptcy
- [Case Review](https://strattondefense.com/case-review) — Confidential intake form for prospective clients (Rule 1.18 protected)

## Key Legal Framework

| Law | What it prohibits |
|-----|--------------------|
| **FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule (TSR)** | Collecting fees before settling or otherwise resolving a debt; misrepresenting success rates |
| **Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA)** | Abusive, deceptive, or unfair debt collection practices; false representations |
| **UDAAP (CFPB)** | Unfair, deceptive, or abusive acts or practices in connection with consumer financial products |
